user.title: Connect to UZMZ
user.description:
Enter your USMS account credentials to monitor your utility meters. You'll be asked to solve a captcha next.

{site_message}

data_description.ic_number: Your IC number used to login to USMS
data_description.save_password: Off (recommended): the password is only used to sign in now, and you type it again whenever USMS asks you to sign in again. On: it is saved in Home Assistant's configuration (unencrypted, like other integrations' passwords) so signing in again only needs the captcha.
data_description.base_url: The USMS SmartMeter website address. Leave the default unless USMS moves the site.

captcha.title: Solve the USMS captcha

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to USMS again
reauth_confirm.description:
The USMS session has ended (signing in on the USMS website or app ends it). Sign in again; you will be asked to solve a captcha next.

{site_message}

data_description.password: Your USMS password. If you chose to remember it, you can leave this blank.

reconfigure.title: Sign in to USMS again
reconfigure.description:
Start a new USMS session, for example after a top-up so the balance updates straight away. You will be asked to solve a captcha next.

{site_message}

data_description.password: Your USMS password. If you chose to remember it, you can leave this blank.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to USMS website. Please check the URL and your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: USMS rejected the IC number or password. Repeated failures will lock your USMS account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs for more information.
error.invalid_captcha: The captcha code was incorrect. A new captcha has been loaded; please try again.

abort.already_configured: This IC number is already configured.

init.title: UZMZ Options
init.description: Configure how often to fetch meter data and whether to remember your password.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch meter data from USMS (minimum 300 seconds, maximum 86400 seconds)
data_description.save_password: Turning this off deletes the saved password now. Turning it on saves your password the next time you sign in.
